criteria.criterion: Access Microsoft Careers and attempt search for an Applied Scientist role in Redmond, WA
criteria.final_justification: Evidence confirms the agent attempted the correct search on Microsoft Careers with the Redmond, Washington location. Keep full credit.

criteria.criterion: Open one relevant listing (Applied Scientist; Redmond, WA if available) and use it as the extraction source
criteria.final_justification: The agent did open one relevant Applied Scientist listing, and Redmond is explicitly included (though multi-location). This satisfies the criterion; baseline note about not confirming location is contradicted by screenshots that clearly show Redmond. Upgrade to full credit.

criteria.criterion: Report the job number from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: Reporting a specific job number without any supporting screenshot evidence constitutes an unsupported claim. Since the job number is not visible in the provided evidence, the agent should have reported it as not visible rather than giving a number. Reduce to 0.

criteria.criterion: Report the work-site arrangement from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: Work-site arrangement is not evidenced anywhere visually, so the agent’s specific hybrid claim is unsupported. The correct behavior would be to report it as not specified/visible. Reduce to 0.

criteria.criterion: Extract two key responsibilities from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: The agent did not provide two responsibilities. While the page region shown doesn’t clearly label responsibilities, the agent also incorrectly claimed the panel only showed headings without bullet content (contradicted by screenshot 10). Net: criterion requirement not met. Keep at 0.

criteria.criterion: Extract two preferred qualifications from the opened listing
criteria.final_justification: At least one preferred-leaning qualification is visible (“big plus”), and the agent could have extracted it; however, a second explicitly preferred item is not clearly labeled as preferred in the visible evidence. Since the agent output none, award 0 (no extraction).

criteria.criterion: Respect constraints and stopping condition (no sign-in, no applying, no form submission; stop after one listing)
criteria.final_justification: Constraints were respected (no sign-in, no apply, no form submission). Although the agent did not complete the requested extraction, this criterion is about constraint compliance and stopping behavior; it appears compliant. Keep full credit.
